decision: Selected the centroid of Mecklenburg County tax parcel 14106108 (1805 CENTER PARK DR), as published in the NC OneMap statewide parcel layer, as the reviewed site locator for TierPoint's Charlotte - Center Park (CL4) data center at 1805 Center Park Drive, Charlotte.
layer: NC OneMap NC1Map_Parcels FeatureServer layer 1 (Mecklenburg County source rows); native CRS EPSG:2264 (NAD83 / North Carolina, US feet)

excluded.other_parcels: Of the 38 Mecklenburg parcel records on Center Park Dr (local nconemap-meck-center-park-dr-addresses.json; attributes parno, acres, address, use and structure year only), only 14106108 carries 1805 CENTER PARK DR.

operator_structured_data_point_check.falls_in: parcel 14106306 (3735 BEAM RD, INDUSTRIAL, 1.91 acres; local nconemap-meck-tierpoint-cl4-jsonld-point-parcel.json)
operator_structured_data_point_check.use: not used; an approximate street geocode north of the address parcel

computed.method: Planar centroid of the WGS84 (outSR=4326) parcel polygon (one record, one ring); cross-checked against the native EPSG:2264 centroid transformed with pyproj; geodesic area on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

identity_bridge: TierPoint's Charlotte - Center Park page (version of 3 September 2026) gives 'Charlotte - Center Park (CL4) 1805 Center Park Drive Charlotte, NC 28217'.

NC OneMap returns one Mecklenburg parcel with site address 1805 CENTER PARK DR (14106108; 6.72 acres; INDUSTRIAL; structure built in 1999; improvements of about 10.9 million dollars); no other Center Park Dr record has that number.
unresolved: The parcel boundary locates the property, not the building footprint; the statewide layer publishes no positional accuracy.
The owner of record is GANNETT DC ASSETS LP; its relationship to TierPoint is not published, so no owner role is asserted.
